idiom-31-q26.truthCondition: Amir and his business partner do not work well together because they argue angrily about almost every choice.
idiom-31-q26.correctReason: 答句的「No」回應合作是否順利；正確句保留阿米爾與生意拍檔幾乎每個選擇都會爭吵。

foils.text: No. Amir and his business partner fight like cat and dog about one unusual choice.
foils.reason: 「one unusual choice」把幾乎每個選擇都吵改成只為一項特殊選擇而吵。

foils.text: No. Amir and his business partner fight like cat and dog about almost every deadline.
foils.reason: 「deadline」把爭議由幾乎每個選擇改成幾乎每個截止日期。

foils.text: No. Amir and his business partner discuss almost every choice calmly together.
foils.reason: 「discuss ... calmly」把激烈爭吵改成平靜討論。

idiom-31-q27.truthCondition: Josh and Ethan became flatmates two months ago and have argued fiercely about housework ever since.
idiom-31-q27.correctReason: 「Since ... became flatmates」和現在完成進行式保留兩個月前開始、至今仍持續的家務爭吵。

foils.text: Before Josh and Ethan became flatmates, they had fought like cat and dog over housework.
foils.reason: 「Before」把爭吵移到同住前；原題說兩人自同住後才一直爭吵。

foils.text: Since Josh and Ethan became flatmates, they have been fighting like cat and dog over rent.
Since Josh and Ethan became flatmates, they have divided the housework without arguing.
foils.reason: 「without arguing」說兩人能和平分工，與原題持續激烈爭吵相反。

idiom-31-q28.truthCondition: Priya and her older sister used to argue angrily often, but now resolve problems calmly.
idiom-31-q28.correctReason: 正確句用「do not ... any more」表明昔日激烈爭吵已停止，並保留兩人現時冷靜討論。

foils.text: Priya and her older sister still fight like cat and dog whenever they discuss problems.
foils.reason: 「still」表示現在仍激烈爭吵；原題說兩人如今會冷靜討論。

foils.text: Priya and her older sister did not fight like cat and dog before, but they do now.
foils.reason: 這句把昔日常吵、現在平靜的時間線完全倒轉。

foils.text: Priya and her older sister never had angry arguments and still talk calmly now.
foils.reason: 「never had angry arguments」抹去了原題說兩人以前總是激烈爭吵。

idiom-31-q29.truthCondition: The two singers appeared friendly on stage but argued angrily nearly every day away from the audience.
idiom-31-q29.correctReason: 正確句保留台上友好、離開觀眾視線後常激烈爭吵的反差。

foils.text: The two singers seemed friendly on stage, but often fought like cat and dog in front of the audience.
foils.reason: 「in front of the audience」把爭吵移到觀眾面前；原題說爭吵發生在觀眾看不到的地方。

foils.text: The two singers seemed unfriendly on stage, but often fought like cat and dog when away from the audience.
foils.reason: 「unfriendly on stage」改變原題台上看來友好的情況。

foils.text: The two singers seemed friendly on stage and remained close friends when they were away from the audience.
foils.reason: 「remained close friends」抹去了兩人私下幾乎每天激烈爭吵的反差。

idiom-31-q30.truthCondition: Continuing to share a desk will probably cause the twins to argue fiercely about the available space.
idiom-31-q30.correctReason: 正確句保留「繼續共用書桌」這個條件、對空間的爭議，以及「很可能」而非必然的預測。

foils.text: Using separate desks will probably make the twins fight like cat and dog over space.
foils.reason: 「separate desks」把繼續共用書桌的條件改成各用一張書桌。

foils.text: Continuing to share the same desk will certainly make the twins fight like cat and dog over space.
foils.reason: 「will certainly」把原題的「很可能」提升成必然。

foils.text: Continuing to share the same desk will probably help the twins settle the space issue calmly.
foils.reason: 「settle ... calmly」把很可能爭吵改成很可能和平解決。
